exposure: demographic characteristics (gender, age, education, marital status)
outcome: level of community knowledge about HSV-2 transmission, recurrence, and asymptomatic shedding
attitudes towards condom use for HSV-2 prevention
cohort: The study included 304 community members residing in the Al-Jouf region, Saudi Arabia, with 56% being females and 44% aged between 21-30 years.
finding: A significant proportion of young participants (21-30 years old) demonstrated a lack of knowledge regarding HSV-2 being an STD, its recurrent nature, asymptomatic transmission, vertical transmission, and effective protection methods.
cross-section timing: N/A (specific timing not mentioned, but data collected at a single point)
